items.title: Nearly $1M in Pokémon and sports cards vanish from FedEx truck, driver discovers missing lock
items.content_text: A FedEx driver discovered a missing cargo-door lock and nearly $1 million in stolen trading cards outside a California grading facility. Detectives are reviewin…
